## What's new

- RetroAchievements is called RetroAchievements: the main menu's sign-in row, the in-game menu and a game's info now say so, where they said Cheevos.

Coming from 1.0.0: update once with ChaOS Installer (Update keeps your games, saves and settings), as for 1.1.0. On 1.1.0, MENU > Updates installs this one over Wi-Fi.

---

ChaOS 1.1.1 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v1.1.1-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v1.1.1-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
